results.description:
His family disapproved. He ran away. His mother destroyed her reputation. His title now gives him the power to choose…

Benedict Sterling has returned home as the new Earl of Rochester, determined to set right the mistakes of his past, until he is confronted with the full consequence of the harm he caused the woman he once loved. Now, he must earn Eugenie's forgiveness and choose between duty, reputation, and his own happiness despite the expectations of society and his family, or else he will lose his only chance at love.

Eugenie Barton has made peace with life on the fringes of society, but the return of a man from her past threatens the fragile security she has worked so hard to achieve after the complete destruction of her reputation. Now, Eugenie must protect her hard-won dignity and guard her heart despite his renewed attention and the whispers that still follow her, or else she risks losing what little acceptance she has achieved.

A Matter of Reputation is a clean Regency romance novel featuring a low-angst with themes of redemption, reputation, and the enduring power of love. Although the story itself is not religious, the content is suitable for anyone looking for a Christian Regency romance book.

This novel is a work of human craftsmanship. It was conceived, written, edited, and the cover designed through human creativity and effort.
This book is a standalone novel and can be read independently of the rest in the series.
No Spice Romance * No Swearing * No Cheating * No Cliffhangers *
